package: @astryxdesign/cli

# Updates and notices

Your global install checks for a newer version once a day and prints a two-line notice after a command succeeds. It never upgrades itself or a project.

## The notice

Once a day, never in your first day, your global install checks the registry's `latest` version in the background, without slowing the command. When a newer one exists, a command that succeeds prints two lines on standard error, at most once a day:

```text
A new release of Astryx is available: 0.7.2 → 0.7.3
To upgrade, run: npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli@latest
```

- The command is the one for the package manager that installed your global install: `npm i -g`, `pnpm add -g`, `yarn global add`, `bun add -g`, or `volta install`. A global folder moved with the package manager's own setting (`BUN_INSTALL`, Yarn's `global-folder`, `PNPM_HOME`, or npm's prefix) counts while that setting names it; an app's own copy never runs the update check.
- When the newest version needs a newer Node than your computer runs, the second line says which Node to install first.
- Inside a project, the notice is about the project's version, and names the project's install and `upgrade` commands. The install command always adds the CLI next to Core, so a project that installed only Core gets its own CLI too, as recommended.

## In a project

```text
A new release of Astryx is available: 0.7.1 → 0.7.3
To upgrade, run: pnpm add @astryxdesign/core@0.7.3 @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.3, then pnpm exec astryx upgrade --from 0.7.1 --apply
```

## Turn it off

No notice prints with `--json`, after a failed command, when the `CI` environment variable is set, or when `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` is set; with either variable set, the CLI does not check the registry either. Unlike some CLIs, a notice prints even when standard error is not a terminal, because agents run the CLI without one.

`npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor` shows the same thing at any time, in its `newest-release` check, along with why the last notice did not print, if one did not. When the last check ran, and when each notice printed, are kept in `state.json` in the settings folder (`npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/reference`).

## More on global mode

This page is part of `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`, which explains what global mode is and how each part works. Upgrading a project: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/upgrade`.
